subject: Fraud & Scams
title: OneCoin: The Fake Cryptocurrency
description: Learn OneCoin: The Fake Cryptocurrency in one minute.

hook.text: OneCoin raised $4 billion from investors worldwide. It wasn't a real cryptocurrency at all.

buildup.text: Founder Ruja Ignatova called herself the 'Cryptoqueen' and filled stadiums with believers.

discovery.text: OneCoin had no blockchain. The 'exchange' was a database the company controlled entirely.

twist.text: Ignatova vanished in 2017 and is now on the FBI's Ten Most Wanted list.

climax.text: Millions of victims in over 175 countries lost their savings to a coin that never existed.

punchline.text: She sold a currency with no blockchain — to millions.

quiz.question: What was fundamentally fake about OneCoin?
